title: Two Month Timeline for Presidential Reference

content.scenario: A Bench of the State Commission differed in opinion on a point and made a reference to the President. The President is now considering the point and needs to give an opinion.
content.outcome: According to the proviso to sub-section (3) of Section 58, the President shall give an opinion on the point referred within a period of two months from the date of such reference.

user_queries: What is the timeline for the President to give an opinion on a referred point under the Consumer Protection Act?
Can the President extend the timeline for giving an opinion?
What happens if the President does not give an opinion within the specified timeline?
